title.narrative: CRED-From Waste to Worth: Circular Banana Economy in Rural Vietnam
CRED-From Waste to Worth: Circular Banana Economy in Rural Vietnam

description.narrative:
Overall Objective: Increased uptake of responsible and circular economy practices by local collaborative groups, including women led organizations in banana values chain in Lao Cai Province.
Expected Results 1. Enhanced technical and operational capacities of 500 farmers, and 5 collaborative groups in sustainable banana production and circular economy practices, leading to increased income and reduced environmental impact in Lao Cai. 2. Strengthened management, leadership, and marketing capacities of 5 collaborative groups, with a focus on women-led groups, enabling resilient and market-integrated banana value chains in Lao Cai. 3. Recognition of the banana circular economy model by Lao Cai authorities and financial institutions, supported by documented best practices and policy advocacy, to promote replication and sustainability.
Outputs Output 1.1: 500 farmers, including at least 300 women, trained in sustainable banana cultivation and circular economy practices, with 80% demonstrating improved knowledge and adoption of organic farming and waste valorization techniques by the end of Year 2. Output 1.2: Five collaborative processing workshops established through co-investment, equipped with fiber extraction machines and tools for mushroom cultivation, worm farming, and microbial fertilizer production, operational by the end of Year 1. Output 2.1: Five fully operational collaborative groups established and capacitated, including at least three women-led groups, with clear organizational structures, governance systems, and business plans, and with leaders trained in key business and management skills to generate income from circular products by the end of Year 2. Output 2.2: Market linkages established for 5 collaborative groups, with at least and 20% of products marketed through e-commerce platforms by the end of Year 2. Output 3.1: A comprehensive toolkit and 2 case studies documenting the banana circular economy model developed and disseminated to Lao Cai authorities and stakeholders by the end of Year 2. Output 3.2: Two policy workshops conducted with Lao Cai authorities and financial institutions, resulting in at least one policy recommendation or financing mechanism proposed to support circular agriculture by the end of Year 2.
